when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.text: If speaking to the Friendly Forester near the Nemus Retreat:

steps.npc: Greetings, or nilsal, as they say in these parts! Have you come to talk forestry?

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.text: If speaking to any other Friendly Forester:

steps.npc: Greetings! Have you come to talk forestry?

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.npc: That's right! In this day and age, we need those trained in the way of the forester now more than ever!

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.player: Way of the forester? What do you mean?

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.npc: You know, helping the woodland flourish with your fellow foresters! And of course, drinking plenty of tea to fuel yourself while you do so!

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.player: Sounds interesting. How can I get started?

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.text: If the player does not have level 15 Woodcutting:

steps.npc: Well, I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey. Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!

steps.player: I'll do that. Thanks for the information.

when-spoken-to-for-the-first-time.text: If the player has at least level 15 Woodcutting:

steps.npc: First, you'll need a forestry kit. Once you have one, all you need to do is chop some trees while you have it on you. The woodland will do the rest!
Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you. My shop has all sorts of useful items.
It is, but I find it's better to let the forests do the talking. You'll understand once you get going. Speaking of which, would you like one of those kits now? I have them free of charge in my shop.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello again! How goes your forestry journey?

options.text: I'd like to trade with you.

steps.player: I'd like to trade with you.

options.text: Could you tell me more about forestry?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about forestry?

steps.npc: It's very simple. All you need is a forestry kit. I have them free of charge in my shop. Once you have one, just chop some trees while you have it on you. The woodland will do the rest!
Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you. My shop has all sorts of useful items.
Speaking of which, would you like to trade now?

standard-dialogue-using-pheasant-tail-fe.npc: I'll happily buy those off you in my shop.
